resources.string: Push matching pairs together. Clear a seeded board in as few shots as possible
Place the steel projectile anywhere in the base, pull back and release to push the coloured pucks
The same seed recreates the same pairs. Each difficulty has its own best score.
This attempt will be replaced. Your records and recent seeds will be kept.

Clear all six pairs in as few shots as possible. Place the steel projectile anywhere in the shaded base, pull back to aim and release. The projectile only pushes: two coloured pucks of the same colour must touch to disappear. No larger puck is created.

The projectile disappears at the end of each turn. Shots are unlimited. Several pairs can disappear during one shot. The base bounces returning pucks back into play.

Easy has no obstacle. Hard adds a sliding wall: wait for an opening or use it to deflect pucks. Between shots, it turns around when it meets a resting puck, without moving it. During a shot, it can push pucks. A turn ends when motion settles, or after 10 seconds if the wall keeps things moving.

The dotted guide stops at the first predicted impact, using the current wall position. The wall can move before your projectile arrives.

Replay seed resets the pairs and the wall to their original positions. Choose a board lets you enter a seed and select the difficulty. Recent seeds lets you return to earlier boards. Records count the fewest shots for a completed board, separately for each seed and difficulty. Your current attempt is saved when you leave.
